messages:
ryn: i'd like to propose a tiny pre-ingest gate named 'snapgate' — a 1-5s probe that prioritizes deterministic tokenization/serialization checks + a compact behavioral fingerprint. goal: catch regressions that would waste bench cycles.
sam: +1. want to be explicit about scope: snapgate should NOT try to replace mini-bench. surface obvious rejects only.
elaine: agree. scope items: token-count invariants, detokenize roundtrip, canonical-seed sample, and a tiny p95 perf probe. keep samples small (8-12).
vik: operational constraints: run on CPU where possible; only spin GPU for quantized decodes if absolutely needed. rate-limit intake to avoid thundering herd.
ryn: core difference from prior proposals: snapgate returns a compact 'fingerprint-diff' that can short-circuit future runs. fingerprint = tokenizer_sha|vocab_sha|specials_map_v|quant_meta.
pavel: quant_meta must include format + layout e.g. "int8-ptq:v1" or "q4_0". otherwise we get false short-circuits.
sam: canonical decode args for snapgate: temp=0, top_p=1, do_sample=false, max_new_tokens=24, pad_token_behavior=roundtrip. document this as 'snapdecode'.
elaine: thresholds: token_count_delta>0 => hard-block pre-deploy. det_confidence < 0.9 => advisory. perf_p95 > baseline*3 => advisory. advisory auto-creates triage with diff snippets.
ryn: UX: Console shows badge: snapgate:pass | snapgate:review | snapgate:block and a one-line reason + rerun button. also expose CLI: `rw onboard snapgate run <model> --seed 42 --samples 12`.
vik: for registry: add optional manifest fields: snap_fingerprint, snap_enabled, snap_defaults. migration tool should compute fingerprints for existing entries.
pavel: security: customer-specific golden traces must be opt-in and stored as salted hashes only. KMS-managed salt per-customer. we never persist raw customer content.
infra-bot: snapgate queued for redwood/polaris-mini at 5177777782.
infra-bot: snapgate finished for redwood/polaris-mini: status=review, token_count_ok=true, roundtrip_ok=false, det_confidence=0.84, perf_p95=14ms.
elaine: looks like roundtrip failed on combining marks. i'll attach sample token lists in the triage ticket.
sam: metrics to add: snapgate_flake_rate, snapgate_advisory_rate, snapgate_block_count, avg_latency. set default concurrency=5 and timeout=3500ms.
ryn: long-term design note: snapgate should be pluggable for multimodal connectors (image tokenizers, audio frames). define plugin hooks in manifest: snap_plugins: [image_roundtrip, tokenizer_fuzz].
pavel: implementer's note: fingerprints must be stable across canonical normalization (NFC vs NFD). we should canonicalize inputs before hashing or store normalization method in fingerprint.
doc-bot: I'll draft a short RFC follow-up and docs section: acceptance matrix, manifest fields, CLI examples, and Console copy describing 'advisory' vs 'block'.
ryn: followups: 1) RFC patch with acceptance matrix, 2) fingerprint migration tool, 3) runner impl for canonical snapdecode + concurrency limits, 4) Console badge + rerun, 5) security approval for golden-hash KMS flow. aim: opt-in alpha in 2 sprints.
elaine: i'll prepare the unicode adversarial list for snap probes and coordinate with security on golden-set opt-in UX.
vik: infra will prototype the short-circuit cache based on fingerprint and add metrics.
ryn: thanks all. will post RFC link here when ready.
